message.content: In the conversations, Li Hua expresses enthusiasm for improvisation during the jam sessions. For instance, during a discussion about potential songs to mix jazz elements with rock, Li Hua suggests, "I was thinking we could have some fun with 'Here Comes the Sun' again. It's such a feel-good song!" Li Hua also anticipates the fun of playing together, stating, "Jamming out will be a great way to relieve some stress." Furthermore, when Wolfgang Schulz mentions the possibility of exploring fusion music, Li Hua agrees, saying, "Totally agree! Mixing those genres could bring out some amazing creativity." This indicates Li Hua's openness and support for improvisation and experimentation within the jam sessions.
